name: spreadconnect-mcp
description: SPOD / Spreadconnect (Spreadshirt) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_order,

platform_mcp_spreadconnect_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SPREADCONNECT_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_spreadconnect_access_token.description: Spreadconnect API token (create an API Integration in the Spreadconnect web app; the token is on its dashboard), sent as the `X-SPOD-ACCESS-TOKEN` header.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /authentication returns {merchantId, pointOfSaleId, pointOfSaleName, pointOfSaleType} for the token.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /articles lists the articles (your products) of the point of sale: {items[{id, title, description, variants[{id, sku, productTypeName, appearanceName, sizeName, d2cPrice, b2bPrice}], images[{imageUrl}]}], count, limit, offset}. `query` and `category` are not accepted; `sku`/`price` are the first variant's (price = d2cPrice, the end-customer price).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /articles/{articleId}: {id, title, description, variants[...], images[...]}; order lines use the variant `sku`. Stock per variant is in GET /stocks (not mapped).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /orders/{orderId}: {id, orderReference, externalOrderReference, state (NEW, CONFIRMED, PROCESSED, CANCELLED), orderItems[{sku, quantity, state, price}], shipping{address, type, price}, price{amount, currency}}. Tracking codes come from the track tool.

tools.name: track
tools.description: GET /orders/{orderId}/shipments returns [{id, orderItemReferences, shipping{type{company, name}, price}, tracking[{code, url}], closedDate, sentDate}]; each shipment is one event (its first tracking code).
